definition: An abstract, typically lower-dimensional space in which a model represents compressed, learned features of its input data.
details: Latent space representations capture underlying structure and relationships in data that may not be obvious in the raw input, and are central to how generative models like VAEs and diffusion models produce novel outputs.
story: Think of an orchestra warming up: no single instrument carries the piece, but together they make the sound. Boil it down and it is this: An abstract, typically lower-dimensional space in which a model represents compressed, learned features of its input data. Here is why it matters: Latent space representations capture underlying structure and relationships in data that may not be obvious in the raw input, and are central to how generative models like VAEs and diffusion models produce novel outputs. The shape of the machine is half the idea. That blueprint is Latent Space.
